lines.title: A day in the life of a Malaysian litigator.
lines.ep1-p1: Six ten. Alarm. Check e-Review before anything else.
lines.ep1-p2: Teh tarik, less sugar. Read the affidavit again.
lines.ep1-p3: Eleven kilometres to Jalan Duta. Forty-eight minutes.
lines.ep1-p4: Black gown, white bands. High Court only.
lines.ep1-p5: Fourteen matters listed. We are number nine.
lines.ep2-p1: All rise. The court is in session.
lines.ep2-p2: Eight matters before ours. Ninety-five minutes of waiting.
lines.ep2-p3: With your leave, Yang Arif. Summary judgment, Order fourteen.
lines.ep2-p4: Decision reserved. Seventeenth of November, nine a.m.
lines.ep2-p5: Case management. A new writ. Fourteen days to defend.
lines.ep3-p1: Forty-seven emails. Nine draft replies waiting.
lines.ep3-p2: New client. Facts first, names hidden, then the draft.
lines.ep3-p3: Afternoon rain. Thirty-eight pages of submissions.
lines.ep3-p4: Affidavit affirmed before the Commissioner for Oaths.
lines.ep4-p1: Home, with two files on the passenger seat.
lines.ep4-p2: Six authorities read. Two of them used.
lines.ep4-p3: Nine point four hours billed. Sixteen awake.
lines.ep4-p4: Tomorrow: Sessions Court, nine a.m. Trial, day one.
lines.end: Cloak, by Lawgistics. Take the client out before you use AI.
